evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Holiday/vacation home or villa; qualified colloquial prison recognition.
rows.sourceNote: Not any hotel or residence. Ordinary home/house categories alone do not establish a synonym guard.

rows.mappingNote: Separate, respective or different; explicit noun-modifying and 別々に constructions.
rows.sourceNote: 別別 is a valid spelling. Raw adverbial gloss is retained without teaching unrestricted bare-adverb syntax.

rows.mappingNote: Experienced person or old hand in a particular field.
rows.sourceNote: Not specifically a military veteran; search-only ヴェテラン is not promoted as a production alternative.

rows.mappingNote: Helicopter; independently verified abbreviation ヘリ.
rows.sourceNote: ヘリコプタ is search-only, not a recommended alternative. Aircraft-category membership does not make an airplane a helicopter.

rows.mappingNote: Transitive editing/compilation of written material or recorded video.
rows.sourceNote: Rare 編修/編輯 recognized. Editorial as a committee modifier is not the opinion article 社説. 編む has an actual compilation/editing sense.

rows.mappingNote: べんじょ toilet/restroom; cautious comparison with トイレ and courteous お手洗い.
rows.sourceNote: Public wrapper's separate historical びんしょ hairdressing room is not this reading. No blanket always-rude claim.

rows.mappingNote: Combination/cutting pliers for gripping, bending or cutting wire.
rows.sourceNote: Not every tool or every pair of pliers. Distinguish ニッパー wire cutters and broader プライヤー without fabricating links.

rows.mappingNote: Telescope for observing distant objects.
rows.sourceNote: 望ボウ+遠エン+鏡キョウ; no invented hope etymology. 鏡 word card exists but no kanji card; retain all three primary characters.

rows.mappingNote: Direction/compass bearing, with thought-direction and method/means recognition.
rows.sourceNote: 角 is voiced ガク in the complete word. Do not restrict absolutely to physical compass directions or erase the method sense.

rows.mappingNote: Broom, usually written ほうき; recognize 帚.
rows.sourceNote: Historical ははき in the public wrapper is not the target reading. Keep primary 箒 metadata although its kanji card is absent.

rows.mappingNote: Dialect/regional expression, with qualified social-group language extension.
rows.sourceNote: Includes vocabulary, grammar and pronunciation, not accent alone. 言葉 has an actual dialect sense; generic language-category membership alone is insufficient.

rows.mappingNote: Familiar/respectful Buddhist priest or monk; familiar boy secondary sense.
rows.sourceNote: お坊さん verified separately. Not every religious clergyperson; honorific familiarity is not a formal-title guarantee.

rows.mappingNote: Prevention/check with transitive する and noun-modifying prevention compounds.
rows.sourceNote: 事故を防止する means prevent accidents, not inspect them. Supplemental public チェック sense4 explicitly covers screening to prevent unsuitable entry, so categorical semantic separation would be false.

rows.mappingNote: Policy, course or plan of action, and guiding principle.
rows.sourceNote: Not merely a numerical objective. Sense2 magnetic needle is expressly original meaning, not a default modern object label; コース has an actual policy sense.

rows.mappingNote: Transitive packing/wrapping and public outer-wrapping recognition.
rows.sourceNote: Homophonous 放送 is a different lexical entry. Package contents, packing actions and outer wrappers require sense-specific comparisons.

rows.mappingNote: Law/rule, including prescribed rules and regular relationships under specified conditions.
rows.sourceNote: Not restricted to natural laws; 法律 is legal law, while 規則/決まり have ordinary rule overlap. 方則 recognized as an alternate spelling.

rows.mappingNote: Medical bandage/dressing and bandaging with する; practical に巻く construction.
rows.sourceNote: Rare 繃帯 recognized. English medical dressing does not license the food/clothing Japanese ドレッシング family.

rows.mappingNote: Huge/vast な-adjective plus qualified swelling/expansion noun and intransitive する recognition.
rows.sourceNote: Rare 厖大/尨大 are limited to adjective sense1. Supplemental 厖大 public entry directly corroborates huge/very numerous; 広々 actually means spacious/expansive, not an invented extensive label.

rows.mappingNote: Common prioritized 包丁 for the raw source's same-entry 庖丁 kitchen knife.
rows.sourceNote: Prioritized 包丁 is the production headword; 庖丁 is recognized. No invented 包+丁 meaning or historical derivation. Archaic cooking/food sense is outside practical teaching scope.
rows.identityNote: Spelling normalization only: 包丁 and 庖丁 share entry 1515530 and reading ほうちょう. Preserve raw 庖丁, reading, gloss and entry; explicit alias recognition in the article, not a duplicate mapping or a different lexical identity.

rows.mappingNote: Mathematical equation/formula plus figurative established method for achieving a result.
rows.sourceNote: Explain unknowns and an equality holding for particular values, with a natural solving example. Not every 式 or 公式 is an equation; 型 has an actual formula sense.

sourceAccessLimits: All eleven selected family chunks307/663, seventeen complete older-body chunks133 and both related-kanji chunks8 actually read through EOF. Preparation and hash verification are not proxies for comprehension.
Three additional complete families/six senses and complete 大きな,別れ,別れる articles were directly read. The actual distinct union is310/669 and136 older bodies, not all497/1083 prepared families.
All twenty principal families/28 senses,267 navigation labels and34 component records were read. Principal families are included in the inspected union, not added again.
Twenty principal and two supplemental complete public lexical wrappers were read. All are Digital Daijisen via Weblio, not22 independent dictionaries.
Mixed public 便所 readingsべんじょ/びんしょ and 箒 readingsほうき/ははき require identity separation. Public numbering is not pinned JMdict numbering.
The confusable inventory was read through line157 plus targeted relevant matches, not in its entirety.
Direct filesystem lookup found no current 刑務所,牢獄,僧侶,坊主,お坊さん,やり方,膨れる,広大 or訛り article. No broken links or hypothetical current-card guards are invented for these forms.
Spelling normalization 庖丁 to common prioritized 包丁 preserves the same family1515530 and readingほうちょう; raw source fields remain frozen.
Safeguards are direct, symmetric, nontransitive hypotheses using actual labels and ordinary senses, not category cliques, model-certified truth, exhaustive corpus uniqueness or runtime quiz proof.
Author actual inspection is not independent review, native-speaker certification, measured frequency or measured model-bias reduction.

quizGuardRationale: Draft direct symmetric nontransitive hypotheses from actual labels, bodies and ordinary secondary senses; do not inherit a neighboring clique.
別々 includes respective/different/separate/individual uses. Parting and bereavement comparisons remain distinct hypotheses, not automatic breakup meanings.
ベテラン concerns field experience; expert-person titles need direct evaluation, not an all-person clique. Helicopters, brooms and combination pliers are not every related vehicle/tool.
編集 compares 編む's actual compilation/editing sense. 便所 compares actual toilet titles without declaring every handwashing use a toilet.
方角's selected thought-direction and method senses matter. 方針 compares actual policy/plan/principle/course senses, not every goal.
方言 compares 言葉's actual dialect sense. 坊さん includes the familiar boy sense; religious-category proximity alone is insufficient.
防止 compares prevention and actual restraint meanings. Supplemental チェック sense4 prevents an unsupported categorical separation; inspection alone is not prevention.
包装 distinguishes wrapping/packing actions from every package content or container. Medical 包帯 does not inherit food/clothing ドレッシング senses.
法則 includes rule/law beyond nature alone. 方程式 includes mathematical and figurative formula/method senses; not every number or mathematical object is an equation.
膨大's adjective and swelling/expansion senses require direct checks. 広々 actually says spacious/expansive, not extensive; no blanket expansion-category or size clique is asserted.
包丁 is the prioritized common same-entry spelling of raw 庖丁; knife comparison does not imply every cutting tool. Alias recognition is not another primary N2 pair.
Author reads and structural checks are not independent review, native certification, exhaustive semantic uniqueness or measured model-bias reduction.
